newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentina's Menem says no cabinet changes for now.
newsitem.headline: Argentina's Menem says no cabinet changes for now.

text.p: Argentine President Carlos Menem denied press speculation he was set to make changes in his cabinet, newspapers reported Tuesday.

"Nothing of the kind," Menem was quoted by Clarin as saying in Vina del Mar, Chile, after the Iberoamerican summit late Monday. "They (the press) have changed my cabinet about 1,000 times recently, but I have not thought about changing the cabinet."
Press reports have said Menem will change some members of his team in the next few weeks to put a fresh face on the government ahead of legislative polls next year.
"Let's not forget that the person who appoints and removes ministers is the president and, for now, there is nothing."
